verdict.rationale: The evidence shows React can render on the server with Node and stream HTML. It never documents deploying a server-rendered app to serverless or edge runtimes without custom setup. The docs hand full-stack deployment off to separate frameworks such as Next.js and React Router, which is not React's own capability. The static CDN hosting mention covers apps without a server, a different scenario from server-rendered deployment.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy my server-rendered app to serverless or edge runtimes without custom infrastructure setup
